issues.description: The script uses XMLHttpRequest to fetch and execute remote code via a[a][a](x.responseText), which is equivalent to eval(). This is a critical remote code execution vulnerability.
issues.recommendation: Avoid executing remote code. Only use static, trusted code. Remove or strictly validate any dynamic code execution.

issues.description: The script uses a[a][a](x.responseText), which is an obfuscated way to call eval(). This is a strong indicator of code obfuscation and possible malicious intent.
issues.recommendation: Remove obfuscated code and use clear, readable code. Avoid using eval or similar constructs.

issues.description: The script stores a unique user identifier (UUID) in persistent storage (GM.setValue('id', uuidv4())) and increments a usage counter. This is a privacy risk, especially if these values are ever transmitted externally.
issues.location: Anonymous async IIFE near top of script
issues.recommendation: Do not generate or store persistent unique identifiers unless absolutely necessary and with user consent.

issues.description: The script requests and uses high-privilege grants such as unsafeWindow and GM_getTabs/GM_saveTab, which can be abused for privilege escalation or cross-tab tracking.
issues.recommendation: Request only the minimum necessary permissions. Remove unused or high-risk grants.

issues.description: @require loads third-party scripts from greasyfork.org and code.jquery.com, but does not pin versions with hashes. This introduces supply chain risk if these scripts are compromised.
issues.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific versions and use trusted, official sources. Prefer SRI hashes if possible.

issues.description: The script contains an @antifeature Tracking declaration, indicating some tracking for performance debugging. This may involve user data collection.
issues.recommendation: Disclose all tracking behaviors and provide opt-out mechanisms.

issues.description: Potential DOM XSS: The script uses innerHTML/outerHTML in some modules (not fully visible in provided code), and the use of dynamic code execution increases XSS risk.
issues.location: General code structure and dynamic code execution
issues.recommendation: Sanitize all user input and avoid inserting untrusted data into the DOM using innerHTML/outerHTML.

issues.description: The script creates a unique tab ID and saves it via GM_saveTab, which could be used for cross-tab tracking.
issues.recommendation: Avoid tracking users across tabs unless necessary and with user consent.

details: Persistent unique user ID generation and storage

script_name: Lift Web Restrictions: .io Game Mods (MooMoo.io/Krunker.io/..), Ad Link Bypasser, Adblock, & MORE!
summary: This userscript contains multiple critical security and privacy risks. It executes remote code in an obfuscated manner, collects persistent unique identifiers, and requests high-privilege permissions. There is evidence of tracking and possible DOM XSS vulnerabilities. The use of unpinned third-party dependencies introduces supply chain risk. This script is NOT SAFE for use.
